thread:
maggie (product): FYI — Aurora Retail came back with a scoped ask for a private deployment. They want VPC + air-gapped option, tenant-level HSM, and EU data residency. Sales is pushing for a proof-of-concept and a Q3 pilot. Can we triage feasibility and rough timeline?
matt (sales): +1. They're firm on HSM and no egress from their subnet. Budget pre-approved if timeline is < 12 weeks.
sam (eng): Need specifics on network topology and expected QPS. Also whether they need model training infra or just inference.
tara (solutions): I asked them for expected peak concurrent requests and token/sessions/day. They replied: ~15 rps peak, 1.2M tokens/day, mostly chat. No training.
jules (security): HSM + airgap usually needs a legal review for import/export and a dedicated network carveout. Also need to know which KMS/HSM vendor.
maggie (product): They're open to Redwood-managed HSM via partner or customer-provided HSM behind a VPN. Priority is that private keys never leave customer VPC.
sam (eng): Ok. Immediate checklist items: 1) network egress rules, 2) magneto/kernel compatibility with quantized runtimes, 3) GPU node accessibility from their subnets, 4) audit log integration.
tara (solutions): I'll push for a minimal PoC: single model variant, one GPU, certs + KMS wired to their HSM, and a simple inference route. That should prove closed-network deploy.
matt (sales): They also asked for service-level latency targets: 99th <= 350ms for 256-token responses. Is that achievable in VPC?
sam (eng): Possibly with Dedicated config and KV cache warmup. Depends on region + instance type. Need to validate with perf run.
jules (security): Add compliance ask: PCI-ish data flows? They said "payment tokens may be passed" — we should assume high sensitivity. Recommend we require SOC2 + penetration test window.
maggie (product): Proposed next steps: 1) schedule 30m triage w/ eng + security + solutions this week, 2) collect network diagram + HSM vendor + sample payloads, 3) open intake ticket with priority and tentative timelines.
infra-bot: New intake ticket created: RF-2026-487 (private-deploy / aurora). Owner: sam.
sam (eng): I'll run an initial feasibility bench and a simple perf estimate. ETA 5 business days. Will post results here.
tara (solutions): I'll draft a customer-facing scope doc and a short checklist for them to provide infra details.
jules (security): I'll start a compliance pre-check and list required artifacts. Expect questions about key custody and pen-test schedule.
maggie (product): Great. I'll own follow-up with the customer and sync timelines to sales. Meeting invite going out: "Aurora private deploy triage" — ping me if you need a different time. :calendar:
